cell_system: mouse primary bone-marrow macrophages, in vitro
field_parameters_verbatim: no magnetic field; 25 mg/ml (verbatim) 24 h pretreatment, then 4 h LPS
axis_contrast: none (particle dose is single-valued; no field)
control_arm: CON untreated; silica particle comparator present
title: Dysregulation of Macrophage Activation Profiles by Engineered Nanoparticles
triage_note: Dose recorded verbatim as 25 mg/ml; the Fe gate report judges this almost certainly a unit error for 25 ug/mL and flags it for checking against PMID 23808590. Contains LPS-free arms, so it is NOT a co-stimulus-only design.

field_parameters_verbatim: no magnetic field; 0.01 and 0.1 ug/ul, 12 h
axis_contrast: none per criteria 3a-3d (two particle doses, but dose is not field amplitude and there is no field)
title: RNAseq analysis of silica coated magnetic nanoparticles treated BV2 cells
triage_note: The only two-level particle-dose series in the myeloid core ring.

cell_system: mouse 4T1 breast tumour, Drop-seq scRNA-seq; TAM the stated focus
field_parameters_verbatim: mild magnetic hyperthermia (alternating field); amplitude and frequency not stated in archive; 24 h
title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals ferrimagnetic vortex nanoring-mediated mild magnetic hyperthermia exerts antitumor effects by alleviating tumor-associated macrophages suppression
triage_note: Thermal, not mechanical, actuation - relevant to the core ring by the pre-registered criteria but not to the placement axis.

cell_system: mouse whole organs (bone marrow, spleen, liver, lung, lymph node, tumour) plus magnetically sorted nanoparticle-associated cells
field_parameters_verbatim: no magnetic field; 5 mg Fe/mouse single i.v.; 7 days
title: Iron oxide nanoparticles inhibit tumor progression and suppress lung metastases in mouse models of breast cancer [RNA-seq]
triage_note: PMID 38564478. Whole-organ, not sorted myeloid; admissible contrast is BP vs PBS. Already triaged in the project's Fe scan.

cell_system: mouse skeletal muscle, FACS-sorted infiltrating macrophages (Ly6Chi CFSEhi) and single muscle fibres
field_parameters_verbatim: external magnet used for delivery/targeting, not actuation; 1 / 2 / 3 weekly i.v. infusions; harvest day 30
axis_contrast: none per criteria 3a-3d (the varied quantity is injection number, not field amplitude)
title: External magnetic-field driven delivery of exosomes modulates immune and metabolic changes of dystrophic muscle I

cell_system: mouse skeletal muscle, FACS-sorted infiltrating macrophages
magnetic_agent: magnetic vs non-magnetic exosomes (NT-MAG-ExoMyo vs NT-ExoMyo)
field_parameters_verbatim: external magnet for delivery; 3 weekly i.v. infusions
axis_contrast: none per criteria 3a-3d (magnetic vs non-magnetic carrier is a material contrast, not placement/frequency/amplitude/field-mode)
title: External magnetic-field driven delivery of exosomes modulates immune and metabolic changes of dystrophic muscle II
triage_note: Nearest miss to an axis contrast in a myeloid system: the magnetic and non-magnetic arms are otherwise matched, but what differs is carrier composition, not how the actuator is driven.

cell_system: mouse bone-marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDC), in vitro
field_parameters_verbatim: low-frequency magnetic field (LMF); no numeric field strength or frequency in the archive; harvest 6 h
title: An intracellular magnetic torque-regulator drives mechano-sequential antitumor immunity [RNA-seq]
triage_note: CONTRADICTION: the overall_design states three treatments - 'Control, magnetic rod-shaped micromotors (MagRMs), and LMF' - but only two arms (Control n=4, LMF n=4) are deposited. The MagRM-only arm that would have made this Tier A is not in GEO. Closest DC analogue of the Li lysosomal route; PMID 40944369.

field_parameters_verbatim: rotating magnetic field, 1 Hz (stated in overall_design)
control_arm: 'control group' - the archive does not state whether control cells received nanomotors without field
title: Dynamic magneto-mechanical force in lysosomes instructs durable macrophage repolarization for antitumor immunity.
triage_note: If the control arm carries nanomotors this is a 3d field-mode contrast and Tier A; the archive does not say. Classified B on the conservative reading. Already used by manuscript M.

cell_system: mouse subcutaneous tumour, scRNA-seq, all cells (myeloid pseudobulk formable)
field_parameters_verbatim: rotating magnetic field; frequency not stated in archive (1 Hz in the companion in-vitro series GSE273977); 14 days
axis_contrast: 3d field-mode: PBS vs MNM-only vs MNM+RMF
title: Dynamic magneto-mechanical force in lysosomes instructs durable macrophage repolarization for antitumor immunity
triage_note: Three-arm design is the only archived myeloid dataset that separates the particle term from the field term. Already used by manuscript M (three-arm modality projection).

cell_system: mouse B16-OVA tumour, scRNA-seq, all cells (myeloid pseudobulk formable)
field_parameters_verbatim: IIMT = programmed rotating magnetic field, high-then-low torque sequence; numeric field/frequency not stated in archive; 10 days, harvest 24 h after last treatment
axis_contrast: 3d field-mode: PBS vs MagRM-only vs MagRM+IIMT
title: An intracellular magnetic torque-regulator drives mechano-sequential antitumor immunity
triage_note: Same three-arm logic as GSE275018 but n=2 per arm, below the pre-registered qualified-Tier-A threshold of 3.

cell_system: mouse liver, scRNA-seq (Kupffer cells / monocytes recoverable)
field_parameters_verbatim: static magnetic field (SMF); amplitude not stated in archive
title: Static magnetic field ameliorates hepatic injury via Piezo1 as a magneto-mechanical effector [scRNA-Seq]
triage_note: Every animal received CCl4; there is no injury-free arm. This is the F analogue of M's excluded 'mechanical + LPS vs LPS' class.

cell_system: mouse 4T1 orthotopic tumour, CITE-seq (GEX+ADT), immune lineages profiled
field_parameters_verbatim: low-intensity electromagnetic field ('Asha Therapy'), 7 days; amplitude and frequency not stated in archive
title: CITE-seq of 4T1 orthotopic mammary tumors treated with low-intensity electromagnetic field (Asha Therapy)
triage_note: Field without an actuator - the useful 'is the field alone inert?' control, but with no particle arm.
